result.title: Jumping up and down: Denoiser diffusion models for discrete ordinal data
result.summary: Diffusion models are highly developed in continuous spaces for image and video domains. Recently, major advances have been made for discrete diffusion models for categorical data, specifically in the language domain. In contrast, diffusion models for discrete integer-valued data are less developed, despite the prevalence of this modality, ranging from images and music to gene counts. We introduce Jumping Up and Down (JUD)---a new family of denoiser-based diffusion models for discrete ordinal data. This is the first family of diffusion models for ordinal data which centers around training denoisers, which at the same time allows for bi-directional (up and down) perturbations of the data. The simplicity of the training objective, combined with the flexibility of bi-directional perturbations, leads us to obtain competitive results across different data modalities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JUD，一类面向离散有序数据（整数取值）的去噪器式扩散模型，支持双向扰动，在图像、音乐、基因计数等模态上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作研究离散有序数据的生成建模，未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据使用、停止决策等主线问题，也无可具体核查的 latent 推理借鉴线索。
